newsitem.title: USA: Cabletron Systems Inc Q4 Feb 28 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Cabletron Systems Inc Q4 Feb 28 net rises.

text.p: NOTE: For the quarter and twelve months ended Feb. 28, 1997 and Feb. 29, 1996.

Nonrecurring items in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997 include $12.2 million (net of tax) of nonrecurring engineering and other charges related to the acquisitions of Netlink Inc. and OASys Group Inc.

Excluding these one-time expenses fourth quarter net income would have been $72.6 million or 47 cents per share, compared to net income of $53.4 million or 35 cents per share before acquisition related expenses of $60.8 million (net of tax) in the comparable quarter of the preceding fiscal year.

Included in fiscal 1997 results are $39.2 million (net of tax) of nonrecurring items related to all acquisitions for the fiscal year. Excluding these one-time charges, fiscal 1997 net income would have been $261.4 million or $1.68 per share, compared to fiscal 1996 net income of $1.36 per share before acquisition related expenses of 40 cents per share.
The consensus estimate for the fourth quarter of 1997 was $0.47 per share, according to First Call.
